Source: Dungeons and Dragon Ballz V.3, PDF page 167. Category: equipment. Dragon Balls.

This set is identical to the Earth set other than its iconic
black stars. This set appears to have no limits but the
set scatters accross the universe and if not recollected
in one year the planet that the wish was made on will
explode from negative backlash, the full extent of this
negative backlash is determined by the severity of the
wish granted.
